generations.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production pixel-art DAMAGE ANIMATION ATLAS of the reference Flushfiend toilet monster. Transparent portrait canvas, exactly FOUR COLUMNS and SIX ROWS = 24 separate sprites. Uniform equal cells with wide transparent gutters, consistent creature scale, facing LEFT and consistent foot anchor. No text or labels or grid. Each of first FIVE rows repeats the original four animation poses in order: walk left foot forward, walk right foot forward, hop tucked feet open mouth, hit recoil squeezed eyes. Each ROW represents cumulative damage: ROW 1 healthy clean intact porcelain. ROW 2 mild: one bold diagonal tank crack, chipped lid edge, tiny water drips. ROW 3 moderate: branching dark cracks across tank and bowl, missing small rim chunk, visibly leaking cyan water. ROW 4 severe: large missing tank corner and bowl rim section, heavy cracks, bent pipe leg, stronger sputtering water, but recognizable live toilet. No live standing monster in last row. All 24 sprites fully isolated within cells, equal spacing and foot baseline, generous padding, no cropping. Original image serves as identity and pose reference; generate the complete new 4x6 grid. Genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop, no halo effects or ground shadows, no gore.
